scientific_intent.scientific_task: Render translucent rectangular detection-window overlays onto an RGB image using a fixed source color and opacity. The source supplies synthetic pixels/windows, not detections from a trained model.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For each rectangle and in-image pixel, output=alpha*colorRGB+(1-alpha)*originalInputRGB, alpha=Float32(1/255). All rectangles share color and read original input, so union coverage determines final single-blend output.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 640×480 row-major RGB image,245760 axis-aligned integer rectangles,8×8 GPU blocks per rectangle, upper-edge clipping and dense overlap.
invariants: All output channels finite and within RGB range up to source tolerance.
Every covered pixel equals one source blend, regardless of overlap count; every uncovered pixel equals original input.
All source boxes/launch order/grid extents preserved; all1904647 actual input-prefix values byteexact.
Every921600 RGB output value checked against independent coverage/affine oracle in every model/trial.
accuracy_requirements: Original absolute1e-3 source tolerance for full RGB arrays, plus direct CUDA/CUDA.jl comparisons for allfive trials.
Independent Float64 affine oracle with actual rounded Float32 alpha/ialpha and integer rectangle-union coverage; no GPU work reduction.
Exact actual input image/Box/color/shape prefix, finite outputs, range and two unchanged-pixel checks.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 blending/FMA contraction introduces tolerated real-arithmetic drift; geometry remains actual Int32. Alpha source convention1/255 is preserved rather than changed to opacity1.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Original640×480/0.8pixels box count245760 and source seed123; other resolutions, per-box colors, negative coordinates and alternate alpha conventions unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Computer-vision detection visualization and image compositing primitive, not model accuracy or physics inference.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Full-batch ROI includes many host dispatch calls; no causal host/GPU bottleneck or measured roofline position without profiles. Dense overlap creates redundant but intentionally retained source work.
